escena: Use the attached image as the reference for the woman, her clothes and the location. SAME woman, same face, same low bun, same black collared button-up blouse with rolled sleeves, same tape measure around her neck, same gold heart necklace and red beaded bracelet. SAME shop: the same counter with the white stone top, the same wall on the left, the same racks of gala gowns by color on the right. Same camera position and same 35 mm framing as the reference, chest height, looking slightly down. The ONLY things that change: the paper wall calendar and the sticky notes are gone, the stacks of paper contracts are gone, the chair piled with plastic-bagged gowns is gone; she is standing up relaxed and smiling, holding a tablet with both complete hands, the screen ON and facing the camera showing a clean month calendar grid with several days filled in solid color and one dress thumbnail; behind her only a three-panel mirror and one clear garment bag with a blank numbered tag hanging from a hook on the rail. Calm, organized, warm daylight. Photorealistic editorial photography, 35 mm, natural light mixed with warm store lighting, real people working. Real Mexican street-level formal-dress rental shop: gala gowns on racks sorted by color, clear or white garment bags, a small numbered tag hanging from every hanger, a three-panel mirror. Absolutely no legible text anywhere: no words, no letters, no readable numbers, no printed labels, no signage, no banknotes, no written paper; any paper wall calendar is a blank grid with colored sticky marks instead of digits, the grid lines read as marks, never as figures. Every screen is ON and clearly visible showing a clean month calendar grid with several days filled in solid color and one small dress thumbnail, never readable words or numbers, never a grey or off screen, never a dark photo. Anatomically correct people: complete hands with five clearly separated fingers, natural arm length, relaxed natural poses, no impossible stretched arms, no fused fingers; nothing floats unsupported, every hanger is hooked on the rail or held in a hand. No logos, no brand names, no visible device brand on the back of the tablet.
